text: Clients one month, nothing the next?
spoken: Your fixes each worked a while. Here's why none stuck.
visual: Charcoal cloth on ivory paper; three different scraps sewn on apart, labelled REFERRALS, COLD EMAIL, POSTING, each peeling off at a corner

text: Referrals, cold email, posting. None of it stuck.
spoken: Is your marketing built, or patched? Here's how to tell.

text: "Try a new channel." That's not your problem.
spoken: It's not the channel. Every fix you tried started from scratch.
visual: One big scrap sewn on the cloth, struck through in red behind its label NEW CHANNEL
